overview: The Medford School Committee met to review the fiscal year 2027 preliminary budget recommendations and receive updates on the high school building project. The committee also approved outstanding prior-year invoices, accepted donations, and heard a presentation on a student survey concerning lunch and transportation.

items.title: Executive Session
items.summary: The committee voted to enter into executive session to conduct strategy sessions and contract negotiations regarding non-union personnel.

items.title: Consent Agenda
items.summary: The committee approved the consent agenda, which included budget transfers, school donations, a field trip request, and meeting minutes.

items.title: Mustang Moments and Student Recognitions
items.summary: The committee celebrated student achievements with presentations from the Missituk School Council, the High School Unified Physical Education program, and state poster contest winner Nora Shaw.

items.title: Introduction of Transportation Director
items.summary: The superintendent formally introduced Ina Williams as the district's new transportation manager.

items.title: FY27 Preliminary Budget Recommendations
items.summary: The finance team presented a preliminary budget proposal of $94,032,696 for fiscal year 2027, detailing unavoidable cost increases, facilities requirements, and educational resource needs.

items.title: Gone Green Billing FY25
items.summary: The committee approved payment of $48,665.51 for outstanding fiscal year 2025 electrical invoices from contractor Gone Green.

items.title: Student Advisory Council Survey on Lunch and Transportation
items.summary: Student representatives presented survey findings highlighting student concerns over short lunch periods, cafeteria crowding, and busing safety and late-route needs.

items.title: MSBA Project Update
items.summary: Member Jenny Graham provided an update on the high school building project, focusing on design options, upcoming space allocation votes, and community feedback sessions.

items.title: Condolences and Adjournment
items.summary: The committee expressed condolences to the families of David P. Skerry and Lot Max Parisian before adjourning.
